name: Cleric
summary: A divine caster who heals, protects and smites, with Channel Divinity and a domain's always-prepared spells.

recommended.note: Wisdom first; Protector if you want heavy armor and martial weapons.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Cleric spells with Wisdom; prepare spells from the whole Cleric list each Long Rest.
features.text: You know three Cleric cantrips (more at levels 4 and 10) and can swap one each time you gain a Cleric level. You prepare level 1+ Cleric spells for which you have slots; the number is in the Prepared Spells column, and you can change the list after any Long Rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; a Holy Symbol can be your focus.

features.name: Divine Order
features.summary: Choose Protector (Martial weapons, Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (extra cantrip, bonus to Arcana and Religion).
features.text: Protector: proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor. Thaumaturge: one extra Cleric cantrip, and you add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks.

options.name: Protector
options.summary: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.summary: One extra Cleric cantrip; add Wisdom (min +1) to Arcana and Religion checks.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.summary: Two uses per rest: Divine Spark (heal or harm 1d8 + Wis) or Turn Undead.
features.text: You can channel divine energy twice (one use back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest; more uses at levels 6 and 18). Saves use your spell save DC. Divine Spark (Magic action): a creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Hit Points, or makes a Constitution save, taking that much Necrotic or Radiant damage on a failure and half on a success; the dice grow at levels 7, 13 and 18. Turn Undead (Magic action): each Undead of your choice within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute, fleeing from you, until it takes damage.

features.name: Cleric Subclass
features.text: You choose a Cleric subclass. From now on you gain each subclass feature when you reach its Cleric level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.summary: Turn Undead also deals Radiant damage: d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier.
features.text: When you use Turn Undead, roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1); each Undead that fails its save takes that much Radiant damage, which doesn't end the turning.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Cleric subclass.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.summary: Choose Divine Strike (+1d8 Necrotic or Radiant on a weapon hit) or Potent Spellcasting (+Wis to Cleric cantrip damage).
features.text: Your god lends force to your attacks or your cantrips; choose one. Divine Strike: once on each of your turns, a weapon attack that hits a creature deals an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage, your pick. Potent Spellcasting: your Cleric cantrips add your Wisdom modifier to the damage they deal.

options.name: Divine Strike
options.summary: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of Cleric cantrips.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without a slot.
features.text: As a Magic action, cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that isn't cast as a Reaction, without a spell slot or Material components. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.summary: Divine Strike becomes 2d8, or Potent Spellcasting also grants Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Cleric subclass.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.summary: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take an Epic Boon feat or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet. Boon of Fate is recommended.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.summary: Divine Intervention can cast Wish; then it needs 2d4 Long Rests to recover.
